title: O22a — Discrete logarithms modulo a composite
exact_target: Can a modular discrete logarithm be found deterministically in polynomial time for an arbitrary modulus, including composites, whenever it exists?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8400025 (AMR-083-0025). CC BY 4.0.

Leonard M. Adleman and Kevin S. McCurley, Open Problems in Number Theory Complexity, II, in Algorithmic Number Theory, LNCS 877 (1994), pp. 291--322, C22/O22a, manuscript p. 17 (LNCS p. 307), and Definition 2.
